title: Spike d: local tracker survives restarts

steps.name: Process 1: create task, add two comments, change status, exit
Process 2: commit a comment, then hard kill (SIGKILL)
Process 3: hard kill in the middle of a transaction
Process 4: data intact after restarts, partial transaction rolled back
details: status READINESS, 3 comments, 1 transition, integrity ok, journal wal

steps.name: Same process: create a second task after restart (key sequence continues)
